cohort: Seventy women diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) were included from Bertha Calderon Roque Women's Teaching Hospital.
finding: Women with GDM in Nicaragua experience high rates of maternal and neonatal complications, which are associated with potentially modifiable factors including obesity, inadequate prenatal care, and advanced maternal age, despite 98.6% of mother-infant pairs having favorable overall clinical outcomes.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section occurred in 40% of patients and was significantly associated with obesity (OR = 3.12), advanced maternal age (OR = 4.21), and fewer prenatal visits (OR = 3.97).
